name: IHG One Rewards Premier Business Credit Card

localized_names.en: IHG One Rewards Premier Business Credit Card

apr.notes: 19.24% to 27.74% variable APR. APR is Min of (Prime + 12.49%) and 29.99% to Min of (Prime + 20.99%) and 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

base_rate.description: Earn 3X points per $1 spent on all other purchases.

categories.label: Purchases at hotels participating in IHG One Rewards
Travel (excluding IHG hotels); dining at restaurants (including takeout and eligible delivery); social media and search engine advertising; office supply stores; and gas stations

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for free nights at IHG Hotels and Resorts. Redeem 3 nights, get 4th night free on consecutive four-night stays. Anniversary Free Night each year with 40,000 point redemption cap. Free nights at 4,700+ IHG properties globally.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 140,000 Bonus Points after spending $4,000 in the first 3 months from account opening. Plus, earn 10,000 bonus points after you add an employee card in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Automatic Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: As an IHG One Rewards Premier Business credit cardmember, you qualify for automatic IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status for as long as you remain a Premier Business cardmember.

benefits.title: Anniversary Free Night
benefits.description: Earned each account anniversary year with a current point redemption cap of 40,000 points. You can also use existing points to redeem your Anniversary Night at hotels above the 40,000 point redemption level.

benefits.title: Redeem 3 Nights, Get 4th Night Free
benefits.description: When you redeem points for a consecutive four-night IHG hotel stay, you can receive a fourth Reward Night free redeemable at that same hotel during that same stay.

benefits.title: $100 Statement Credit and 10,000 Bonus Points
benefits.description: Earn a $100 statement credit and 10,000 bonus points each calendar year after you spend $20,000.

benefits.title: Save 20% on Reward Points Purchases
benefits.description: Save 20% when you purchase points with your IHG One Rewards Premier Business Credit Card.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS Statement Credit
benefits.description: Statement Credit of up to $120 every 4 years as reimbursement for the application fee charged to your card.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: If your trip is canceled or cut short by sickness, severe weather and other covered situations, you can be reimbursed up to $1,500 per person and $6,000 per trip for your pre-paid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Get one-year complimentary DashPass, membership for both DoorDash and Caviar. Activate by Dec 31, 2027. Plus, DashPass members get up to $10 off quarterly on non-restaurant DoorDash orders through Dec 31, 2027.

benefits.title: Instacart Credit
benefits.description: Receive a monthly $10 Instacart credit, up to $120 annually, plus a complimentary 3-month Instacart+ membership. Benefits end 12/31/27.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status
other: Fourth Night Free on reward stays
